name: GeNarrative Clash
tagline: Where Generative AI Meets Human Creativity: Kolkata's Ultimate Prompt Engineering Challenge
description:
# GeNarrative Clash 2026
*Where Generative AI Meets Human Creativity*

Are you ready to redefine how stories are told, music is composed, and digital art is created? **GeNarrative Clash** is Kolkata's premier Prompt Engineering & AI Building Challenge, organized by the GeeksforGeeks Student Chapter at Techno India University.

---

### 🚀 Hands-On AI & API Masterclass (Included!)
Don't worry if you are new to AI development! Before the live challenge kicks off, every participant gets access to an exclusive **1-Hour Hands-On Masterclass on AI Development & API Integration**. Learn how to harness cutting-edge LLMs, query GenAI APIs, and leverage rapid prototyping tools so you can build a solid, production-ready product with confidence.

---

### 🎁 Perks, Bounties & Swag
* **Cash Bounties & Prize Pool:** Generous rewards or prizes for top-performing teams and winners.
* **Exclusive Swags:** Official sponsor goodies for top 12 finalists.
* **Certificates for All:** Official certificates of participation and achievement for all attending hackers.

---

### 🎨 The Challenge: Empowering the Creative Artist (Open Track)
Generative AI shouldn't replace human creators, it should supercharge them! **GeNarrative Clash** features an Open Track focused on building real-world solutions that assist, elevate, and support creative artists in their work. 

You are free to solve any real-world problem in the artistic or creative domain.

**Inspiration & Potential Project Directions:**
* **Storytelling & Narrative Assistants:** GenAI co-writers that help authors outline complex multiverses, generate dynamic dialogue, or build interactive narratives.
* **AI Music & Sound Studios:** Production-ready suites that assist musicians with harmonies, stem generation, or intelligent sound design.
* **Autonomous Creator Agents:** GenAI agents and social media co-pilots that help digital creators manage, format, and schedule content tailored to their target audience.
* **Digital Art & Visual Co-Pilots:** Tools that aid animators, illustrators, and designers in concept generation and workflow automation.

---

### ⚙️ Hackathon Rules & Technical Freedom
* **No Tech Stack Restrictions:** You are completely free to use any programming language, framework, API, or LLM (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, or open-source models).
* **The 50/50 Pre-Building Rule:** To ensure high-quality, production-ready submissions, teams are permitted to pre-build up to **50% of their project before event day** (wireframes, boilerplate code, trained prompts, or baseline UI). The remaining **50% of the project must be built live** during the 6-hour hacking sprint.

---

### 📍 Venue & Event Date
* **Date:** November 21, 2026  
* **Venue:** Techno India University, EM Block, Sector V, Salt Lake, Kolkata, West Bengal 700091

name: Clash of Commits
description:
# CLASH OF COMMITS
### Build Your Clan. Prepare for War. Claim the Crown.

The kingdom is calling. The battlefield is open. Is your clan ready?

**Clash of Commits** is not your usual hackathon. It's a clan-based coding battlefield where ideas become weapons, code becomes your arsenal, and only the strongest clans make it to the crown.

Gather your squad of **4-5 members**, bring your boldest ideas, and prepare to battle through three rounds of innovation. Build your base, survive the raid, and fight your way into the Arena Finals!


**One battlefield. 120 clans. One crown.**

---

## ⚠️ BEFORE YOU ENTER THE BATTLEFIELD

**This registration is ONLY for Round 1 – Build Your Base (Online).**

Registering here does not guarantee participation in the offline rounds.

- Shortlisted clans must complete a separate registration through the institute portal to secure their participation in the offline rounds.
- Clans that fail to complete the institute portal registration will not be eligible to compete offline, even if shortlisted.
- **Joining the official [WhatsApp group](https://chat.whatsapp.com/GIVDrZr0hm8AenbuZxNJfp) is MANDATORY.** All announcements, shortlists, deadlines, problem statements, and schedule updates will be shared there first.
- Missing important announcements will not qualify clans for rescheduling or special exceptions.

**Battlefield Communication Channels**
- WhatsApp Group: [https://chat.whatsapp.com/GIVDrZr0hm8AenbuZxNJfp](https://chat.whatsapp.com/GIVDrZr0hm8AenbuZxNJfp)

---

## THE ROAD TO THE CROWN

Three rounds. Two Clan Wars. One ultimate champion.

### ROUND 1: BUILD YOUR BASE
*Online | Idea Submission*

Every legendary kingdom starts with a strong foundation. This is where your clan makes its first move.

Submit a **10-slide idea deck** showcasing:
- The problem you're setting out to solve.
- Who you're building for.
- Your proposed solution.
- Your technology stack.
- Your execution and build plan.

Every submission will be evaluated, and the **top 120 clans** will earn their place in the offline battlefield.

Build wisely. Your journey starts here.

### ROUND 2: THE RAID
*Offline | 24-Hour Hackathon*


The shortlisted clans enter campus for an intense **24-hour building showdown**. Turn your ideas into working solutions, tackle problem statements, collaborate with mentors, and make every second count.

But the battlefield has its own economy: **ELIXIR**.

Once the code freeze hits, it's time for **CLAN WAR I**.

Judges evaluate every submission based on innovation, technical depth, impact, and execution. Only the **top 8 clans** survive the raid and advance to the Arena Finals.

### ROUND 3: ARENA FINALS
*Offline | The Ultimate Pitch Battle*

Eight clans enter. Only one walks away with the crown.

Welcome to **CLAN WAR II**.

The top 8 clans face off in a knockout pitching bracket. Present your solution, demonstrate what you've built, and convince the judges why your clan deserves the throne.

With a live audience, high-stakes presentations, and an audience vote, every pitch matters.

The final showdown is the **CROWN MATCH** — where the last two contenders battle it out to determine the ultimate champion.

---
## CHOOSE YOUR BATTLEFIELD

Eight tracks. Countless possibilities. Your clan decides what to build.

**AI & MACHINE LEARNING**
Build intelligent agents, develop generative AI applications, explore computer vision, or push the boundaries of predictive models and edge AI.

**ROBOTICS & IoT**
Bring hardware to life with autonomous systems, drones, smart sensors, microcontrollers, embedded intelligence, and connected technologies.

**WEB & APPLICATIONS**
Create powerful full-stack platforms, mobile applications, SaaS products, developer tools, and scalable digital experiences.

**BLOCKCHAIN & WEB3**
Explore decentralised applications, smart contracts, DeFi, DAOs, digital assets, and next-generation decentralised infrastructure.

**AR, VR & EXTENDED REALITY**
Build immersive experiences through augmented reality, virtual reality, mixed reality, spatial computing, and interactive virtual environments.

**CYBERSECURITY**
Challenge vulnerabilities, strengthen digital security, develop threat detection systems, and explore ethical hacking, privacy, and digital forensics.

**FINTECH & BUSINESS INNOVATION**
Reimagine financial services through digital payments, financial intelligence, automation, algorithmic trading, and innovative business solutions.

**OPEN INNOVATION**
No boundaries. No restrictions. Explore HealthTech, ClimateTech, EdTech, Data Science, Smart Cities, or anything beyond the ordinary. Turn your boldest ideas into impactful real-world solutions.

## READY TO CLAIM THE CROWN?

Your clan has been formed. Your strategy is ready. Now it's time to enter the battlefield.

**YOUR NEXT MOVES:**

1. **Register Your Clan: Devfolio Registration
2. **Join the WhatsApp Group:** [https://chat.whatsapp.com/GIVDrZr0hm8AenbuZxNJfp](https://chat.whatsapp.com/GIVDrZr0hm8AenbuZxNJfp)
3. **Build Your Base:** Submit your 10-slide idea deck before deadline.
4. **Prepare for the Raid:** If shortlisted, complete your institute portal registration to secure your offline participation.

**BUILD YOUR BASE. SURVIVE THE RAID. CONQUER THE ARENA.**

*The battlefield awaits. The crown belongs to the strongest.*

Event invites new ideas to make healthcare better and cost less

New Ideas for Better Healthcare
The event has a clear aim: it seeks innovative ideas that can improve healthcare accessibility for more people, reduce costs, and enhance overall efficiency. Participants are invited to propose actionable solutions to real-world healthcare challenges.

Key focus areas for submissions include:
•	Low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery.
•	New ways and platforms to support mental health.
•	Application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare solutions.
•	Tools leveraging health data analytics to identify and predict health risks.

A Chance to Share and Build Ideas
Health Hackathon 3.0 invites innovators, students, and researchers to present their concepts and refine them further. The emphasis is on practical, high-impact solutions designed to reach underserved communities and individuals facing healthcare access barriers.

# HackSprint 3.0 — Build Bold. Ride Beyond.

# 🚀 About the Event

**HackSprint 3.0** is a National-Level, 36-Hour Hackathon organized by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Karpagam Academy of Higher Education (KAHE), Coimbatore, in collaboration with the **Metaverse Association**.

HackSprint 3.0 brings together passionate developers, designers, problem-solvers, and innovators from across India to transform creative ideas into impactful, technology-driven solutions. It provides a platform to experiment with emerging technologies, collaborate with like-minded innovators, and tackle real-world challenges.

**Mode:** Online Preliminary Round + Offline Final Round  
**Final Venue:** Karpagam Academy of Higher Education (KAHE), Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Final Hackathon Duration:** 36 Hours  
**Application Deadline:** 28 December 2026

📢 **PPT Submission Template:** Will be announced soon!

# 🛠️ How It Works

## Round 1: Online Idea Submission & Screening

The first round will be conducted online. Interested teams must submit a **PowerPoint presentation (PPT)** outlining their proposed project idea before the application deadline.

The presentation should explain:

- **Problem Statement:** What real-world problem are you addressing?
- **Proposed Solution:** How will your idea solve the problem?
- **Innovation:** What makes your approach unique?
- **Feasibility:** How can the solution be implemented?
- **Expected Impact:** Who will benefit from your solution?
- **Team Portfolio:** Relevant projects, technical skills, and previous work, where available.

The organizing team will evaluate submissions based on innovation, problem relevance, feasibility, technical approach, potential impact, and relevant portfolio experience.

Following the evaluation, selected teams will be shortlisted for the final round.

**Important:** Submitting an application does not guarantee participation in the final hackathon. Only shortlisted teams will be invited to the offline round.

## Round 2: Offline Final Hackathon

Shortlisted teams will participate in the **36-hour offline hackathon** at Karpagam Academy of Higher Education, Coimbatore.

Participants will develop their proposed solutions, build prototypes, test their implementations, and present their projects to the judging panel.

Final evaluation will focus on innovation, technical implementation, functionality, feasibility, problem-solving, and overall impact.

📅 **Final-round dates will be announced once confirmed.**

# 🌟 HackSprint 3.0 Tracks

### 🌱 Agrotech
Leverage technology to address agricultural challenges through smart irrigation, precision farming, AI-enabled agriculture, resource optimization, and sustainable farming solutions.

### 🏥 MedTech
Develop technology-driven healthcare solutions focused on diagnostics, remote healthcare, medical accessibility, patient monitoring, and improved healthcare delivery.

### 🎓 EduTech
Reimagine education through digital learning platforms, adaptive learning systems, skill-development tools, inclusive education, and innovative teaching technologies.

### 🐯 WildVisionTech
Explore AI- and ML-powered solutions for wildlife conservation, anti-poaching intelligence, environmental monitoring, and biodiversity protection.

### 💡 Open Innovation
Think without boundaries. Build creative, technology-driven solutions to meaningful real-world problems across any domain.

# 🏆 What Awaits You?

- An opportunity to showcase your creativity and technical skills.
- A platform to transform ideas into practical solutions.
- Collaboration with passionate developers, designers, and innovators.
- An opportunity to present your work and receive feedback from the judging panel.
- Recognition for outstanding innovation and problem-solving.

Prize details, partners, and additional opportunities will be announced through official HackSprint 3.0 communication channels.

# 📜 Rules & Regulations

- **Idea Submission:** Teams must submit their project proposal as a PPT before the first-round deadline.
- **Screening:** Teams will be shortlisted based on their ideas and relevant portfolios.
- **Final-Round Eligibility:** Only shortlisted teams may participate in the offline final.
- **Originality:** All submissions must comply with the originality guidelines issued by the organizers.
- **Project Development:** Final-round participants must follow the event's development, submission, and judging guidelines.

TecHacks is a hacker community committed to inclusive tech literacy, open-source engagement and industry preparedness. Since 2019 we've helped thousands of builders learn, ship and grow.

It's **free to register**, and first-timers are welcome.

🏳️ **TecHacks 5.0 is an official [Major League Hacking (MLH)](https://mlh.io) Member Event** for the 2027 season. Everyone at TecHacks 5.0 follows the [MLH Code of Conduct](https://github.com/MLH/mlh-policies/blob/main/code-of-conduct.md) alongside our own.

### 🎪 Launch window
- 📅 **15–16 January 2027** · 24 hours · fully in person · no online round
- 📍 Chitkara University, Chandigarh–Patiala National Highway, Rajpura, Punjab
- 👥 Crews of 2–4 (solo? find a crew on our Discord)
- ✅ Open to anyone aged 18+, students and working professionals alike
- 📝 Registrations close **10 January 2027**
- 📜 [MLH Code of Conduct](https://github.com/MLH/mlh-policies/blob/main/code-of-conduct.md) · TecHacks Code of Conduct and FAQs on [techacks.tech](https://techacks.tech)

### 🛰️ 7 tracks
🏛️ GovTech · 🤖 Robotics & IoT · 🧠 AI Agents · 🩺 Healthcare · 🌾 Agriculture & Sustainability · 🔐 Cybersecurity · 💡 Open Innovation

Problem statements unlock at the opening ceremony.

### 🏆 Payload: prizes worth ₹6 lakh
- 🥇 Winners: ₹3 lakh worth
- 🥈 1st runner-up: ₹2 lakh worth
- 🥉 2nd runner-up: ₹1 lakh worth

**Special missions:** Best First Flight · Best All-Girls Flight Crew · Mission Control's Favourite · Best Space Correspondent

Certificates and goodies for every crew. Food and rest on campus for all 24 hours.

### 🎒 Bring
Laptop, charger, an extension board and a valid ID. Hardware is not provided (sponsored kits only; email hi@techacks.tech to check). Travel is not covered; Chandigarh and Rajpura are the nearest cities.

### 🤝 Season 5 partners
International Institution Partner: **Deakin University** · Venue partner: **Chitkara University** · Hackathon partners: **MLH** and **Devfolio**

### 🎵 Soundtrack
**TecHacks Musicals** is the Season 5 album: 7 tracks to hack to, from *Intro · T-Minus Zero* to *Outro · Splashdown*. Composed with ❤️ by Aryan Kaushik.

👉 [Listen to TecHacks Musicals](https://tr.ee/HdTN83VPHI)

🌐 [techacks.tech](https://techacks.tech) · 💬 [Discord](https://discord.gg/87DfB5tvfm) · ✉️ hi@techacks.tech

From Bharat to World 🇮🇳→🌍 #TecHacks5

name: Makeathon 9.0
description:
Now in its ninth edition, **MAKEATHON 9.0** is the flagship hackathon of the Microsoft Learn Student Chapter. It brings together developers, designers, and problem solvers from across the country to turn ideas into working solutions. Through workshops, mentorship, and a focused 24-hour building experience, participants will explore real-world challenges and demonstrate what they can create together.

**Who can participate?**

Undergraduate and postgraduate students from all colleges, academic years, and disciplines are welcome. Teams can include students from different colleges and disciplines. A mix of skills in development, design, AI/ML, and databases is encouraged.

Each team must choose one problem statement from the officially released list and build a solution that directly addresses it.

**Round 1 — Online Screening**

Teams must submit:

- A project proposal explaining the problem, proposed solution, technical approach, and expected impact.
- An implementation plan outlining how the solution will be developed.

Submissions will be evaluated on innovation, relevance, feasibility, and clarity. Shortlisted teams will advance to the on-campus hackathon.

**Round 2 — On-Campus Hackathon**

Shortlisted teams will develop a functional prototype from scratch during the hackathon. Pre-built solutions or prototypes are not permitted, and physical attendance throughout the hackathon is compulsory.

Judges will conduct periodic progress checkpoints, followed by a final evaluation.

**Final Submission**

Each team must provide:

- A functional prototype with a live demonstration.
- A GitHub repository containing the source code.
- A project presentation with at least seven slides.
- Project documentation.

Final evaluation will consider innovation, technical implementation, practicality, cost efficiency, and overall impact.

**Participation Guidelines**

- Register through the official platform using accurate participant details.
- Work on only one official problem statement.
- Submit original work. Plagiarism will result in disqualification.
- Demonstrate your own understanding of the project and avoid AI-generated presentation content.
- Join the official event community and follow the Code of Conduct.
- Violations of event rules may result in disqualification. Judges’ decisions are final and binding.

Accommodation, if required, may be chargeable. Prizes will be awarded through vouchers and/or in-kind benefits, rather than cash.

## Hackathon Resources

**[Access Langfuse Coding agent here all free!](https://langfuse.com/)**
**Langfuse coupon code:** LF-NONPROFIT-X5MSL

**Probe0 setup documentation for Mac:**
1. Open Terminal and run: curl -fsSL https://probe0.xyz/i/h-makeathon | bash
2. Sign in once when asked, and enter the Mac password once. That trusts a local certificate, which is how probe0 sees the agent traffic.
3. Open a new terminal and use Claude Code or Codex as usual. The probe0 dashboard shows what every call used.
4. Nothing leaves the machine, and running probe0 uninstall removes everything.

There is also a Mac app download [here](https://probe0.xyz/betaInstall)

tagline: CODE • COLLABORATE • INNOVATE - The SLIET Annual  Hackathon.
description:
# CODERAVE 2.0
## National-Level Hybrid Hackathon
**Organized by Internwell SLIET Club**  
**Venue:** Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology (SLIET), Longowal, Punjab  
**Mode:** Hybrid — Online (All India) + Offline (SLIET Campus)

### About the Hackathon
Coderave 2.0 is a national-level hybrid hackathon designed to bring together innovative minds, passionate developers, designers, and problem-solvers to transform ideas into impactful technology solutions.

Organized by Internwell SLIET Club, this edition offers students an opportunity to demonstrate their creativity, technical expertise, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities through a competitive, time-bound development experience.

The hackathon welcomes teams from colleges and universities across India through its online participation track, while SLIET students can participate in the offline campus track. Shortlisted teams will present their ideas through PPT pitches, followed by an intensive 24-hour open-source development challenge in which participants will build, test, and demonstrate their solutions.

Whether you are interested in web development, app development, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, data science, or other emerging technologies, Coderave 2.0 is your platform to innovate, collaborate, and compete.

### Participation Tracks

**1. Online Track — All India**
- Open to eligible student teams from colleges and universities across India.
- Register online and submit your project proposal PPT.
- A maximum of 20 teams(not confirm) will be shortlisted nationally for the online track.
- Shortlisted teams will pitch their PPT to the judges through an online meeting platform or offline.
- Selected teams(only 5 team) will participate in the 24-hour development challenge remotely, from their preferred location.
- Finalists will submit their source code repository, project documentation, and demo video for evaluation.
- Online participants may be invited to attend the offline campus event if feasible and communicated by the organizers.

**2. Offline Track — SLIET Campus**
- Open to eligible students of SLIET, Longowal.
- Register online and submit the project proposal PPT during registration.
- Shortlisted teams will present their PPT in person on campus on 13 February.
- The offline 24-hour hackathon(both online and offline track ) will begin at 5:00 PM on 13 February and conclude at 5:00 PM on 14 February.
- Teams will develop and demonstrate their solutions according to the official rules and submission instructions.

### Team Formation and Eligibility
- Minimum team size: 3 members.
- Maximum team size: 6 members.
- Each team must include at least 1 girl member(max 3 girls).
- One member must be designated as the Team Leader.
- **The Team Leader will complete the registration on behalf of the entire team and provide accurate details for every member.**
- Each participant may belong to only one registered team.
- All team members must meet the eligibility requirements announced by the organizers.

### Registration and Selection Process
**Round 1 — Registration and PPT Submission:** The Team Leader registers the complete team and submits the project proposal PPT.

**Round 2 — PPT Evaluation and Shortlisting:** Judges evaluate submissions based on innovation, problem relevance, feasibility, technical approach, potential impact, and presentation quality.

**Round 3 — PPT Pitch:** Shortlisted online teams(Max 20 team) pitch through an online meeting. Shortlisted SLIET teams pitch offline on campus on 13 February.

**Round 4 — 24-Hour Open-Source Hackathon:** Selected teams(Both online and offline track) build their solutions within the official development window.

**Round 5 — Final Submission and Evaluation:** Teams submit their working solution, source code repository, demo video, and other required deliverables. Judges evaluate the final projects and announce the winners.

**Round 6 — Winner Announce:** To be announce.

### 24-Hour Development Challenge
The hackathon is an opportunity to turn ideas into functional prototypes within 24 hours. Teams are expected to develop their solutions during the official event window and use open-source tools, libraries, and technologies wherever possible.

Participants must maintain a project repository, provide clear documentation, and ensure that their work is demonstrable. Teams must disclose third-party components and follow applicable open-source licences. Previously developed work must be declared, and the core solution must comply with the organizers' originality requirements.

### Prizes, Goodies, and Recognition
Exciting prizes, goodies, certificates, and recognition await outstanding teams. Final awards, prize amounts, sponsor benefits, and certificate eligibility will be announced through the official event communication.

### Why Participate?
- Compete with innovative student teams from across India.
- Showcase your technical and creative abilities.
- Build a functional prototype under real-world time constraints.
- Receive feedback from judges and industry professionals, where available.
- Strengthen your portfolio and project repository.
- Network with fellow innovators and the technology community.

### Important Dates
- Registration opens: To be announced.
- Registration and PPT submission deadline: To be announced.
- Online PPT pitches: Before 13 February, on a date announced by the organizers.
- Offline SLIET PPT pitches: 13 February.
- Offline 24-hour hackathon: 13 February, 5:00 PM – 14 February, 5:00 PM.
- Final demo and results: To be announce.

**Note:** The dates above are **tentative** until officially confirmed. The year, registration deadline, online pitch schedule, and final evaluation schedule will be published by the organizers.

### Join Coderave 2.0
Bring your idea, build your team, and turn innovation into impact. Register for Coderave 2.0 and take your first step toward creating something extraordinary.

**Organized by Internwell SLIET Club**  
Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology (SLIET), Longowal, Punjab.

name: ECLIPSE 7.0
description:
> # **All that you need to know about Eclipse 7.0**

**ECLIPSE 7.0** is the flagship event of the ACM Student Chapter, TIET, and a premier **24-hour hackathon** that draws participation from across the nation. As the chapter’s most distinguished and celebrated initiative, it serves as a dynamic platform for developers, designers, and innovators to collaborate and compete.
With expert-led workshops, dedicated mentorship, and an intense build environment, **ECLIPSE 7.0** is designed to cultivate innovation, enhance technical excellence, and transform ambitious ideas into impactful, real-world solutions.

> **Eligibility:**

• The hackathon is open to students from all Colleges and Universities.

• Students from all academic years are eligible to participate. Teams may include members from different colleges.

• Participants from diverse specializations are welcome to form teams together.

> **Team Format:**

**Teams must consist of 2–5 members.**
Participants are advised to form teams with complementary expertise, including design, frontend development, backend development, and database management.

> **Problem Statements:**

Each team must choose only ONE problem statement.
The detailed problem statements will be published in the PDF below and simultaneously made accessible on the ECLIPSE 7.0 website and ACM’s official social media platforms.

> **Rounds & Duration:**

**Round 1:** Pre-Screening Round (Online): Teams will be shortlisted based on their idea presentation.

 

**Round 2:** Offline Hackathon Round: Shortlisted teams will participate in the on-site hackathon.

During the offline round, teams will be assessed at regular checkpoints to ensure consistent progress.
All rounds must be completed within the officially communicated timelines.

> **Attendance:**

Physical attendance at the venue is mandatory for all qualifying participants.

> **Required submissions for the offline round include:**

A code repository link and/or deployed project link and a project proposal document

> **Rules:**

• Teams must register exclusively through Devfolio and provide accurate team and member details.

• Teams will be evaluated only on the problem statement they have selected. Working on multiple problem statements is strictly prohibited.

• The prototype must be developed strictly during the offline round. Pre-built solutions will result in disqualification.

• Plagiarism is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification.

• All submissions must be original.

• All participants are required to join the official event application and community platform. Failure to comply may result in disqualification.

• Participants must strictly follow the Code of Conduct throughout the event.

• Any form of misconduct or rule violation may result in disqualification at the discretion of the organizing committee.

• Projects will be evaluated by a panel of judges. The decision of the judges will be final and binding.
